guidePage.title: Application Guide
guidePage.subtitle: A step-by-step guide to help you successfully apply for funding opportunities on Maali.
guidePage.introDesc: This guide will walk you through the entire application process, from creating your account to submitting your application. Follow these steps to maximize your chances of success.
mistakes: Submitting incomplete applications or missing required documents
Waiting until the last minute to submit your application
Not reading the opportunity requirements carefully
Not responding to requests for additional information
guidePage.resourcesDesc: Explore these additional resources to help you succeed with your application.

steps.title: Create Your Account
steps.description: Start by creating a free account on Maali. You can sign up with your email or use Google for faster registration.

steps.title: Complete Your Profile
steps.description: Fill out your profile with accurate business information. A complete profile increases your chances of approval.

steps.title: Browse Opportunities
steps.description: Explore available funding opportunities. Use filters to find opportunities that match your business sector and needs.

steps.title: Prepare Your Documents
steps.description: Gather all required documents before starting your application. This includes business plans, financial statements, and identification.

steps.title: Submit Your Application
steps.description: Complete the multi-step application form. Take your time to provide accurate and detailed information.
tips: Save your progress if you need to return later

steps.title: Track Your Application
steps.description: Monitor your application status from your dashboard. You'll receive email notifications when there are updates.
tips: Respond promptly to any requests for additional information
Be patient during the review process

bestPractices.title: Be Honest and Accurate
bestPractices.description: Provide truthful information about your business. Misrepresentation can lead to application rejection or future issues.

bestPractices.title: Prepare in Advance
bestPractices.description: Gather all required documents before starting your application to avoid delays and ensure completeness.

bestPractices.title: Follow Instructions
bestPractices.description: Read all instructions carefully and follow them precisely. Each opportunity may have specific requirements.

bestPractices.title: Meet Deadlines
bestPractices.description: Submit your application well before the deadline to avoid last-minute issues and ensure your application is considered.
